value.rationale: An exact answer for a recently introduced locating-dominating coalition invariant on all complete multipartite graphs with no singleton parts, strengthening the known bound r+2 to constant 3/4. Four-block equality is rigid and has an exact all-r enumeration, giving a concrete combinatorial model and counting question not implied by ordinary locating domination or small-graph tables.
